status: Private source frozen for parent migration; no production edit by this agent.
api: bool AgentEngine::appendExternalToolOutput(const QString& requestId, const QString& text)

integration.dependencies: No new dependency; AgentPresentation uses QtCore. Reconfigure core glob for new files.
integration.ui: Use static displayHistory for unhosted persisted chats; displayMessages for hosted chats. Observe displayChanged and coalesce UI rendering. Feed AgentToolHost::output(requestId,text) into appendExternalToolOutput. Attachment announcements may use the same UI-only preview seam with a mounted reference; final attachment refs merge into the originating assistant row.

sourceRationale.behavior: UI stream is merged into ordered message parts independently of environment snapshots.
Stable message IDs, ordered parts, settled-state preservation and per-part timing are tracked separately.
Text/reasoning timing begins when a part first appears; native empty block-start fixtures cover the corresponding display boundary.
Renderer grouping, disclosure/follow rules and remaining UI scope are separately audited.

behavior: Each provider round has one stable assistant row and ordered text/reasoning/tool parts. Provisional state becomes retained without duplicate rows or changed part IDs.
Existing attachments, path references, snapshots and native/signed payloads remain separate and preserved. Display metadata is not sent in any of the four provider protocols.
Tool output rows merge into their originating assistant batch using exact call IDs. Reused IDs in later batches remain independent.
Partial arguments, approval, running, success/error/denial/cancellation and bounded live output are exposed. Final canonical tool results replace live previews.
Display getters do not mutate canonical history. Legacy histories derive deterministic keys and best available parts; unknown timing is omitted.

A reasoning-only interrupted response that the previous native implementation discarded can now persist as an exact, versioned host-created UI-only envelope. It carries no fabricated native signature; only that strict empty envelope is omitted from requests. Real replay fields always prevent filtering.
Measured reasoning duration uses native part start when available, otherwise first observed reasoning content. End is explicit native part completion, transition to another part, or turn termination.

bounds.liveOutputCut: Complete UTF-8 codepoint boundary with truncation marker; later preview chunks ignored for the same token.

productionBefore.result: 4/4 intended cases fail: canceled reasoning is absent from stored messages in each existing provider adapter; lifecycle totals 2 passed,4 failed.

evidence.scope: Loopback fake providers and fake tokens only; no actual credentials, user files or live service requests. Independent private build only. Peer review is bounded source review, not an independent test run.

limits: This is the engine presentation layer, not an exact visual/rendering parity certification; root and qt_port_review own ConversationView and real UI integration.
Old OpenAI histories only retain aggregate reasoning/content, so original interleaving cannot be reconstructed when metadata/native part order never existed.

An entirely empty interrupted part has no meaningful retained canonical content; it remains an ephemeral display row. Reasoning-only nonempty partials are persisted. Pure pre-output errors remain signaled and ephemeral rather than fabricated provider history.

Current provisional provider output is exposed by displayMessages; canonical messages() still retains it at the existing completion/interruption boundary. Mid-stream durable checkpoint and fork capture semantics are a separate lifecycle extension.
At the hard presentation part cap, failure is emitted through failed(); no extra unbounded error part is appended.

Malformed canonical history is not repaired by the projector; existing submission recovery/validation remains authoritative. Source-native tool-specific rendering, Smart allow and actions not yet implemented remain explicit broader port gaps.
UI-only interrupted reasoning retention corrects a native data-loss gap. Identical wire behavior to Stagewise for every provider interruption is not claimed.
Known-key redaction is defense in depth, not a proof that arbitrary transformed secret output cannot leak.
